_description: LTCG WITH grandfathering, genuinely eligible. s.55(2)(ac) applies only to equity shares acquired BEFORE 1 Feb 2018, so the purchase date is 2017-06-01. This test previously used 2020-01-01 -- six years inside the cutoff -- and asserted the step-up anyway, which is how the missing date test in tax_calculator.py survived: the only test covering grandfathering encoded the bug, and its description stated the wrong formula ('effective_cost = max(100, 200)=200') as if it were the rule. Correct rule: cost = HIGHER of actual cost and the LOWER of FMV and sale consideration = max(100, min(200, 300)) = 200. Gain = (300 - 200) * 10 - 50 brokerage = 950. The expected value is unchanged; only the date makes it legitimate.
